(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 1.0 EMERGENCY SAFETY SHUTDOWN & SIL-3 HARDWIRED INTERLOCK EVALUATION                      *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF NOT bEmergencyStop THEN
    bSystemTripped := TRUE;
    bSystemRunning := FALSE;
    bSystemReady := FALSE;
    bPathTrackingActive := FALSE;
    bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := FALSE;
    
    (* Latch Critical SIL-3 Emergency Stop Trip in Alarm Word 1 *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0001; (* Bit 0: Hardware SIL-3 Hardwired E-Stop Broken *)
    
    (* Force immediate fail-safe drive motor torque inhibit *)
    rDriveTorqueCmd_FL_Nm := 0.0;
    rDriveTorqueCmd_FR_Nm := 0.0;
    rDriveTorqueCmd_RL_Nm := 0.0;
    rDriveTorqueCmd_RR_Nm := 0.0;
    
    (* Clamp electro-hydraulic fail-safe emergency spring-applied parking/service brakes *)
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FL_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FR_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RL_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RR_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    rMasterBrakePressureCmd_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
    
    (* Transition directly to safe lockout state *)
    iState := 100;
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(* Reset Latching Alarms when requested by Supervisory Control and permissive is clear *)
IF bResetFaults THEN
    IF bEmergencyStop AND bInverterReady_FL AND bInverterReady_FR AND bInverterReady_RL AND bInverterReady_RR THEN
        dwAlarmWord1 := 16#0000_0000;
        dwAlarmWord2 := 16#0000_0000;
        dwWarningWord := 16#0000_0000;
        bSystemTripped := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 2.0 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (2oo3) SENSOR VOTING ALGORITHMS                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
dwDegradationWord := 16#0000_0000;

(* --- 2.1 Front Magnetic Antenna 2oo3 Lateral Deviation Voting --- *)
rDev_MagY_Front_AB := ABS(rMagDevY_Front_A_mm - rMagDevY_Front_B_mm);
rDev_MagY_Front_BC := ABS(rMagDevY_Front_B_mm - rMagDevY_Front_C_mm);
rDev_MagY_Front_CA := ABS(rMagDevY_Front_C_mm - rMagDevY_Front_A_mm);

bMagFront_A_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Front_A_mm) <= 500.0);
bMagFront_B_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Front_B_mm) <= 500.0);
bMagFront_C_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) <= 500.0);

IF bMagFront_A_Healthy AND bMagFront_B_Healthy AND bMagFront_C_Healthy THEN
    (* Standard 2oo3 Median Selection *)
    IF ((rMagDevY_Front_A_mm >= rMagDevY_Front_B_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Front_A_mm <= rMagDevY_Front_C_mm)) OR
       ((rMagDevY_Front_A_mm >= rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Front_A_mm <= rMagDevY_Front_B_mm)) THEN
        rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := rMagDevY_Front_A_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := rMagDevX_Front_A_mm;
    ELSIF ((rMagDevY_Front_B_mm >= rMagDevY_Front_A_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Front_B_mm <= rMagDevY_Front_C_mm)) OR
          ((rMagDevY_Front_B_mm >= rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Front_B_mm <= rMagDevY_Front_A_mm)) THEN
        rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := rMagDevY_Front_B_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := rMagDevX_Front_B_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := rMagDevY_Front_C_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := rMagDevX_Front_C_mm;
    END_IF;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := (bMagPegDetected_Front_A AND bMagPegDetected_Front_B) OR
                          (bMagPegDetected_Front_B AND bMagPegDetected_Front_C) OR
                          (bMagPegDetected_Front_C AND bMagPegDetected_Front_A);
    (* Discrepancy Alert Threshold (35 mm) *)
    IF (rDev_MagY_Front_AB > 35.0) OR (rDev_MagY_Front_BC > 35.0) OR (rDev_MagY_Front_CA > 35.0) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Front Mag Antenna channel deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMagFront_A_Healthy AND bMagFront_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := (rMagDevY_Front_A_mm + rMagDevY_Front_B_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := (rMagDevX_Front_A_mm + rMagDevX_Front_B_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := bMagPegDetected_Front_A OR bMagPegDetected_Front_B;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Front Mag degraded to 1oo2 (C failed) *)
ELSIF bMagFront_B_Healthy AND bMagFront_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := (rMagDevY_Front_B_mm + rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := (rMagDevX_Front_B_mm + rMagDevX_Front_C_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := bMagPegDetected_Front_B OR bMagPegDetected_Front_C;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Front Mag degraded to 1oo2 (A failed) *)
ELSIF bMagFront_A_Healthy AND bMagFront_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := (rMagDevY_Front_A_mm + rMagDevY_Front_C_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := (rMagDevX_Front_A_mm + rMagDevX_Front_C_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := bMagPegDetected_Front_A OR bMagPegDetected_Front_C;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0008; (* Front Mag degraded to 1oo2 (B failed) *)
ELSE
    rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm := 0.0;
    rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm := 0.0;
    bVotedMagPeg_Front := FALSE;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Front Mag failed completely *)
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Total front navigation sensor loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.2 Rear Magnetic Antenna 2oo3 Lateral Deviation Voting --- *)
rDev_MagY_Rear_AB := ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm - rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm);
rDev_MagY_Rear_BC := ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm - rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm);
rDev_MagY_Rear_CA := ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm - rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm);

bMagRear_A_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm) <= 500.0);
bMagRear_B_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm) <= 500.0);
bMagRear_C_Healthy := (ABS(rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) <= 500.0);

IF bMagRear_A_Healthy AND bMagRear_B_Healthy AND bMagRear_C_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm >= rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm <= rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm)) OR
       ((rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm >= rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm <= rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm)) THEN
        rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := rMagDevX_Rear_A_mm;
    ELSIF ((rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm >= rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm <= rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm)) OR
          ((rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm >= rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) AND (rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm <= rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm)) THEN
        rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := rMagDevX_Rear_B_mm;
    ELSE
        rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm;
        rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := rMagDevX_Rear_C_mm;
    END_IF;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := (bMagPegDetected_Rear_A AND bMagPegDetected_Rear_B) OR
                         (bMagPegDetected_Rear_B AND bMagPegDetected_Rear_C) OR
                         (bMagPegDetected_Rear_C AND bMagPegDetected_Rear_A);
    IF (rDev_MagY_Rear_AB > 35.0) OR (rDev_MagY_Rear_BC > 35.0) OR (rDev_MagY_Rear_CA > 35.0) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0020; (* Rear Mag Antenna deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bMagRear_A_Healthy AND bMagRear_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := (rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm + rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := (rMagDevX_Rear_A_mm + rMagDevX_Rear_B_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := bMagPegDetected_Rear_A OR bMagPegDetected_Rear_B;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0040;
ELSIF bMagRear_B_Healthy AND bMagRear_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := (rMagDevY_Rear_B_mm + rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := (rMagDevX_Rear_B_mm + rMagDevX_Rear_C_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := bMagPegDetected_Rear_B OR bMagPegDetected_Rear_C;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0080;
ELSIF bMagRear_A_Healthy AND bMagRear_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := (rMagDevY_Rear_A_mm + rMagDevY_Rear_C_mm) * 0.5;
    rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := (rMagDevX_Rear_A_mm + rMagDevX_Rear_C_mm) * 0.5;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := bMagPegDetected_Rear_A OR bMagPegDetected_Rear_C;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0100;
ELSE
    rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm := 0.0;
    rVotedMagDevX_Rear_mm := 0.0;
    bVotedMagPeg_Rear := FALSE;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0200;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Total rear navigation sensor loss *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.3 IMU Yaw Angular Rate 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rDev_YawRate_AB := ABS(rYawRate_A_degs - rYawRate_B_degs);
rDev_YawRate_BC := ABS(rYawRate_B_degs - rYawRate_C_degs);
rDev_YawRate_CA := ABS(rYawRate_C_degs - rYawRate_A_degs);

bImuYaw_A_Healthy := (ABS(rYawRate_A_degs) <= 90.0);
bImuYaw_B_Healthy := (ABS(rYawRate_B_degs) <= 90.0);
bImuYaw_C_Healthy := (ABS(rYawRate_C_degs) <= 90.0);

IF bImuYaw_A_Healthy AND bImuYaw_B_Healthy AND bImuYaw_C_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rYawRate_A_degs >= rYawRate_B_degs) AND (rYawRate_A_degs <= rYawRate_C_degs)) OR
       ((rYawRate_A_degs >= rYawRate_C_degs) AND (rYawRate_A_degs <= rYawRate_B_degs)) THEN
        rVotedYawRate_degs := rYawRate_A_degs;
    ELSIF ((rYawRate_B_degs >= rYawRate_A_degs) AND (rYawRate_B_degs <= rYawRate_C_degs)) OR
          ((rYawRate_B_degs >= rYawRate_C_degs) AND (rYawRate_B_degs <= rYawRate_A_degs)) THEN
        rVotedYawRate_degs := rYawRate_B_degs;
    ELSE
        rVotedYawRate_degs := rYawRate_C_degs;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_YawRate_AB > 4.0) OR (rDev_YawRate_BC > 4.0) OR (rDev_YawRate_CA > 4.0) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0400; (* IMU yaw gyro channel deviation *)
    END_IF;
ELSIF bImuYaw_A_Healthy AND bImuYaw_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedYawRate_degs := (rYawRate_A_degs + rYawRate_B_degs) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_0800;
ELSIF bImuYaw_B_Healthy AND bImuYaw_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedYawRate_degs := (rYawRate_B_degs + rYawRate_C_degs) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_1000;
ELSIF bImuYaw_A_Healthy AND bImuYaw_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedYawRate_degs := (rYawRate_A_degs + rYawRate_C_degs) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_2000;
ELSE
    rVotedYawRate_degs := 0.0;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_4000;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0010; (* IMU Yaw gyro triple failure trip *)
END_IF;

(* --- 2.4 IMU Lateral Acceleration 2oo3 Voting --- *)
rDev_AccelLat_AB := ABS(rAccelLat_A_ms2 - rAccelLat_B_ms2);
rDev_AccelLat_BC := ABS(rAccelLat_B_ms2 - rAccelLat_C_ms2);
rDev_AccelLat_CA := ABS(rAccelLat_C_ms2 - rAccelLat_A_ms2);

bImuLat_A_Healthy := (ABS(rAccelLat_A_ms2) <= 12.0);
bImuLat_B_Healthy := (ABS(rAccelLat_B_ms2) <= 12.0);
bImuLat_C_Healthy := (ABS(rAccelLat_C_ms2) <= 12.0);

IF bImuLat_A_Healthy AND bImuLat_B_Healthy AND bImuLat_C_Healthy THEN
    IF ((rAccelLat_A_ms2 >= rAccelLat_B_ms2) AND (rAccelLat_A_ms2 <= rAccelLat_C_ms2)) OR
       ((rAccelLat_A_ms2 >= rAccelLat_C_ms2) AND (rAccelLat_A_ms2 <= rAccelLat_B_ms2)) THEN
        rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := rAccelLat_A_ms2;
    ELSIF ((rAccelLat_B_ms2 >= rAccelLat_A_ms2) AND (rAccelLat_B_ms2 <= rAccelLat_C_ms2)) OR
          ((rAccelLat_B_ms2 >= rAccelLat_C_ms2) AND (rAccelLat_B_ms2 <= rAccelLat_A_ms2)) THEN
        rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := rAccelLat_B_ms2;
    ELSE
        rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := rAccelLat_C_ms2;
    END_IF;
    IF (rDev_AccelLat_AB > 0.8) OR (rDev_AccelLat_BC > 0.8) OR (rDev_AccelLat_CA > 0.8) THEN
        dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0000_8000;
    END_IF;
ELSIF bImuLat_A_Healthy AND bImuLat_B_Healthy THEN
    rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := (rAccelLat_A_ms2 + rAccelLat_B_ms2) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0001_0000;
ELSIF bImuLat_B_Healthy AND bImuLat_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := (rAccelLat_B_ms2 + rAccelLat_C_ms2) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0002_0000;
ELSIF bImuLat_A_Healthy AND bImuLat_C_Healthy THEN
    rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := (rAccelLat_A_ms2 + rAccelLat_C_ms2) * 0.5;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0004_0000;
ELSE
    rVotedAccelLat_ms2 := 0.0;
    dwDegradationWord := dwDegradationWord OR 16#0008_0000;
    dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0020;
END_IF;

(* --- 2.5 IMU Longitudinal Acceleration & Roll Angle Voting --- *)
rVotedAccelLong_ms2 := (rAccelLong_A_ms2 + rAccelLong_B_ms2 + rAccelLong_C_ms2) / 3.0;
rVotedRollAngle_deg := (rRollAngle_A_deg + rRollAngle_B_deg + rRollAngle_C_deg) / 3.0;
rVotedRollRate_degs := (rRollRate_A_degs + rRollRate_B_degs + rRollRate_C_degs) / 3.0;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 3.0 STATIC & DYNAMIC MASS RECONSTRUCTION, 3D COG & LATERAL LOAD TRANSFER (LTR) OBSERVER   *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Convert corner load cell mass readings from metric tons [t] to kilograms [kg] *)
rMass_FL_kg := MAX(rCornerWeight_FL_t * 1000.0, 1000.0);
rMass_FR_kg := MAX(rCornerWeight_FR_t * 1000.0, 1000.0);
rMass_RL_kg := MAX(rCornerWeight_RL_t * 1000.0, 1000.0);
rMass_RR_kg := MAX(rCornerWeight_RR_t * 1000.0, 1000.0);

rMass_Total_kg := rMass_FL_kg + rMass_FR_kg + rMass_RL_kg + rMass_RR_kg;
rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t := rMass_Total_kg / 1000.0;

(* Sanity check total mass against structural design envelope (tare ~ 31.5t, max ~ 72.0t) *)
IF (rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t > 70.0) THEN
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0001; (* AGV gross overload > 70t safety trip *)
ELSIF (rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t < 28.0) THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0001; (* Corner load cell underweight anomaly *)
END_IF;

rMass_FrontAxle_kg := rMass_FL_kg + rMass_FR_kg;
rMass_RearAxle_kg  := rMass_RL_kg + rMass_RR_kg;
rMass_LeftTrack_kg := rMass_FL_kg + rMass_RL_kg;
rMass_RightTrack_kg:= rMass_FR_kg + rMass_RR_kg;

(* Longitudinal CoG Position Relative to Front and Rear Axles [m] *)
(* By static moment equilibrium: l_f * m_front = l_r * m_rear, with l_f + l_r = L *)
rCoG_DistRear_m  := (rMass_FrontAxle_kg / rMass_Total_kg) * rWheelbase_L_m;
rCoG_DistFront_m := rWheelbase_L_m - rCoG_DistRear_m;
rEstimatedCoG_OffsetX_mm := (rCoG_DistRear_m - (rWheelbase_L_m * 0.5)) * 1000.0;

(* Transverse CoG Position Offset from Centerline [m] *)
rCoG_LatOffset_m := ((rMass_RightTrack_kg - rMass_LeftTrack_kg) / rMass_Total_kg) * (rTrackWidth_W_m * 0.5);
rEstimatedCoG_OffsetY_mm := rCoG_LatOffset_m * 1000.0;

(* CoG Height Reconstruction: Empirical base chassis height (1.15m) + container payload contribution *)
IF (rContainerGrossWeight_t > 5.0) THEN
    (* High-cube container center of mass is typically 1.45m above chassis bed (bed height ~ 1.75m) *)
    rCoG_HeightEst_m := 1.20 + (rContainerGrossWeight_t / rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t) * 1.65;
ELSE
    rCoG_HeightEst_m := 1.15; (* Tare chassis bare CoG height *)
END_IF;
rEstimatedCoG_Height_m := rCoG_HeightEst_m;

(* Compute Dynamic Lateral Load Transfer Ratio (LTR): *)
(* LTR = (Fz_left - Fz_right) / Fz_total *)
rDynamicLTR := (rMass_LeftTrack_kg - rMass_RightTrack_kg) / rMass_Total_kg;
(* Apply first-order low-pass filter to reject dynamic suspension vibrations (tau = 40 ms) *)
rFilteredLTR := (rFilteredLTR * 0.80) + (rDynamicLTR * 0.20);
rLateralLoadTransferRatio := rFilteredLTR;

(* Check for Severe Lateral Load Imbalance or Container Eccentricity *)
IF (ABS(rCoG_LatOffset_m) > 0.450) THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0002; (* Dangerous container eccentric transverse loading *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 4.0 ACTIVE ANTI-ROLLOVER DYNAMIC LIMIT ENVELOPING & TURNING SPEED GOVERNOR                *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Theoretical rollover boundary based on steady-state equilibrium:                         *)
(* ay_critical = g * (W / 2) / h_CoG                                                       *)
(* With path curvature kappa [1/m], critical speed v_crit = SQRT(ay_critical / (|kappa| + eps)) *)
IF (ABS(rRefPathCurvature_radm) > 0.0005) THEN
    rCriticalRollOverSpeed_ms := SQRT((rGravitationalConstant * (rTrackWidth_W_m * 0.5)) /
                                     (MAX(rEstimatedCoG_Height_m, 0.8) * ABS(rRefPathCurvature_radm)));
    rCriticalRollOverSpeed_kmh := rCriticalRollOverSpeed_ms * 3.6;
ELSE
    rCriticalRollOverSpeed_kmh := 35.0; (* Straight-line maximum terminal governed limit [km/h] *)
END_IF;

(* Calculate Dynamic Roll Stability Margin *)
rRollStabilityMargin := 1.0 - ABS(rFilteredLTR);

(* Dynamic Rollover Multi-Stage Protection Envelope *)
IF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.88) THEN
    (* STAGE 3: CRITICAL IMMINENT ROLLOVER TRIP *)
    dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0002; (* Severe rollover threshold LTR > 0.88 *)
    bAntiRolloverActive := TRUE;
    rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor := 0.0;
    rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := 0.0;
    (* Rapid controlled straight-ahead counter-action & mechanical braking *)
    iState := 80; (* Enter State 80: Active Anti-Rollover Emergency Recovery *)
ELSIF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.65) THEN
    (* STAGE 2: ACTIVE DYNAMIC INTERVENTION *)
    bAntiRolloverActive := TRUE;
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0004; (* Active Anti-Rollover Governor intervening *)
    (* Proportional derate factor: scale speed down linearly to 25% *)
    rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor := MAX(0.20, (0.88 - ABS(rFilteredLTR)) / (0.88 - 0.65));
    (* Generate stabilizing counter-yaw moment Mz to unload outside wheels *)
    IF (rFilteredLTR > 0.0) THEN
        (* Left wheels overloaded, vehicle turning right or rolling right: yaw counter-torque *)
        rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := -15000.0 * (ABS(rFilteredLTR) - 0.65);
    ELSE
        (* Right wheels overloaded, vehicle rolling left: yaw counter-torque *)
        rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := 15000.0 * (ABS(rFilteredLTR) - 0.65);
    END_IF;
ELSIF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.50) THEN
    (* STAGE 1: ADVISORY SPEED DERATING *)
    bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;
    rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor := 0.80; (* Mild 20% speed derating *)
    rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := 0.0;
ELSE
    (* STAGE 0: STABLE ENVELOPE *)
    bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;
    rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor := 1.00; (* 100% nominal speed permitted *)
    rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Enforce anti-rollover speed limit constraint *)
rMaxSafeTurningSpeed_kmh := MIN(rCriticalRollOverSpeed_kmh * 0.85, 30.0) * rAntiRolloverSpeedDerateFactor;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 5.0 MAGNETIC TRANSPONDER LANDMARK EXTRACTION, NAVIGATION FUSION & EKF CORRECTION         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Calculate fused ground speed and chassis kinematics *)
rWheelLinVel_FL_ms := (rWheelSpeed_FL_kmh / 3.6);
rWheelLinVel_FR_ms := (rWheelSpeed_FR_kmh / 3.6);
rWheelLinVel_RL_ms := (rWheelSpeed_RL_kmh / 3.6);
rWheelLinVel_RR_ms := (rWheelSpeed_RR_kmh / 3.6);

rChassisLongVel_ms := (rWheelLinVel_FL_ms + rWheelLinVel_FR_ms + rWheelLinVel_RL_ms + rWheelLinVel_RR_ms) * 0.25;
rVehicleSpeedEst_kmh := rChassisLongVel_ms * 3.6;
rVehicleYawRateEst_degs := rVotedYawRate_degs;

(* Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) Time Propagation Step (Predict) *)
rEkf_Psi_rad := rEkf_Psi_rad + (rVotedYawRate_degs * (3.14159265 / 180.0) * rSampleTime_Ts_s);
rEkf_X_m := rEkf_X_m + (rChassisLongVel_ms * COS(rEkf_Psi_rad) * rSampleTime_Ts_s);
rEkf_Y_m := rEkf_Y_m + (rChassisLongVel_ms * SIN(rEkf_Psi_rad) * rSampleTime_Ts_s);
rEkf_V_ms := rChassisLongVel_ms;

(* Propagate Diagonal Error Covariance P = P + Q *)
rEkf_P11 := rEkf_P11 + rEkf_Q11;
rEkf_P22 := rEkf_P22 + rEkf_Q22;
rEkf_P33 := rEkf_P33 + rEkf_Q33;
rEkf_P44 := rEkf_P44 + rEkf_Q44;

(* Edge detection on magnetic transponder peg detection *)
bTransponderValidPulse := bVotedMagPeg_Front AND NOT bTransponderFrontPrev;
bTransponderFrontPrev := bVotedMagPeg_Front;

IF bTransponderValidPulse AND bMagneticNavEnable THEN
    (* EKF Measurement Update Step: Peg provides absolute millimeter coordinate reference *)
    (* Front antenna is located at x_ant = +L/2 from vehicle center *)
    rLastPegGlobalX_m := rRefPositionX_mm * 0.001;
    rLastPegGlobalY_m := rRefPositionY_mm * 0.001;
    
    (* Measurement Innovation *)
    rInnovX_m := (rLastPegGlobalX_m + (rVotedMagDevX_Front_mm * 0.001)) - rEkf_X_m;
    rInnovY_m := (rLastPegGlobalY_m + (rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm * 0.001)) - rEkf_Y_m;
    
    (* Kalman Gain Calculation *)
    rGainK1 := rEkf_P11 / (rEkf_P11 + rEkf_R_MagX);
    rGainK2 := rEkf_P22 / (rEkf_P22 + rEkf_R_MagY);
    
    (* State Correction *)
    rEkf_X_m := rEkf_X_m + (rGainK1 * rInnovX_m);
    rEkf_Y_m := rEkf_Y_m + (rGainK2 * rInnovY_m);
    
    (* Covariance Matrix Update: P = (1 - K) * P *)
    rEkf_P11 := (1.0 - rGainK1) * rEkf_P11;
    rEkf_P22 := (1.0 - rGainK2) * rEkf_P22;
    
    (* Re-anchor heading error from dual front-rear antenna baseline *)
    IF (bVotedMagPeg_Rear) THEN
        rEkf_Psi_rad := rEkf_Psi_rad + 0.15 * ((rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm - rVotedMagDevY_Rear_mm) / (rWheelbase_L_m * 1000.0));
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Populate Global Positioning and Path Tracking Deviation Outputs *)
rGlobalPositionX_mm := rEkf_X_m * 1000.0;
rGlobalPositionY_mm := rEkf_Y_m * 1000.0;
rLateralPathDev_mm  := rVotedMagDevY_Front_mm;
rHeadingAngleDev_deg := (rRefHeadingAngle_deg - (rEkf_Psi_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265));

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 6.0 NON-LINEAR TIRE ROAD-ADHESION DYNAMIC OBSERVER & SLIP SYNCHRONIZATION ENGINE         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Convert corner loads to Normal Forces in Newtons: Fz = Mass_kg * 9.80665 *)
rFz_FL_N := rMass_FL_kg * rGravitationalConstant;
rFz_FR_N := rMass_FR_kg * rGravitationalConstant;
rFz_RL_N := rMass_RL_kg * rGravitationalConstant;
rFz_RR_N := rMass_RR_kg * rGravitationalConstant;

(* Dynamic Calculation of Longitudinal Slip Ratio for each corner:                           *)
(* lambda = (omega * R_eff - v_x) / MAX(v_x, omega * R_eff, 0.5)                             *)
IF (rWheelLinVel_FL_ms >= rChassisLongVel_ms) THEN
    (* Driving Mode: Positive Slip *)
    rSlipRatio_FL := (rWheelLinVel_FL_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rWheelLinVel_FL_ms, 0.5);
ELSE
    (* Braking Mode: Negative Slip *)
    rSlipRatio_FL := (rWheelLinVel_FL_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rChassisLongVel_ms, 0.5);
END_IF;

IF (rWheelLinVel_FR_ms >= rChassisLongVel_ms) THEN
    rSlipRatio_FR := (rWheelLinVel_FR_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rWheelLinVel_FR_ms, 0.5);
ELSE
    rSlipRatio_FR := (rWheelLinVel_FR_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rChassisLongVel_ms, 0.5);
END_IF;

IF (rWheelLinVel_RL_ms >= rChassisLongVel_ms) THEN
    rSlipRatio_RL := (rWheelLinVel_RL_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rWheelLinVel_RL_ms, 0.5);
ELSE
    rSlipRatio_RL := (rWheelLinVel_RL_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rChassisLongVel_ms, 0.5);
END_IF;

IF (rWheelLinVel_RR_ms >= rChassisLongVel_ms) THEN
    rSlipRatio_RR := (rWheelLinVel_RR_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rWheelLinVel_RR_ms, 0.5);
ELSE
    rSlipRatio_RR := (rWheelLinVel_RR_ms - rChassisLongVel_ms) / MAX(rChassisLongVel_ms, 0.5);
END_IF;

(* Clamp Slip Ratios within physical bounds [-1.0, +1.0] and output in percent *)
rTireSlipRatio_FL_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rSlipRatio_FL * 100.0, 100.0);
rTireSlipRatio_FR_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rSlipRatio_FR * 100.0, 100.0);
rTireSlipRatio_RL_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rSlipRatio_RL * 100.0, 100.0);
rTireSlipRatio_RR_pct := LIMIT(-100.0, rSlipRatio_RR * 100.0, 100.0);

(* Recursive Friction Coefficient Observer (Mu Estimation) *)
(* Total tractive force produced by 4 drive motors: F_tract = sum(Torque_i / R_eff) *)
rTractiveEffortTotal_N := (rDriveMotorTorqueFb_FL_Nm + rDriveMotorTorqueFb_FR_Nm +
                           rDriveMotorTorqueFb_RL_Nm + rDriveMotorTorqueFb_RR_Nm) / rTireRollingRadius_m;
rNormalForceTotal_N := rFz_FL_N + rFz_FR_N + rFz_RL_N + rFz_RR_N;

IF (rNormalForceTotal_N > 10000.0) AND (ABS(rChassisLongVel_ms) > 0.5) THEN
    rApparentFrictionDemand := ABS(rTractiveEffortTotal_N) / rNormalForceTotal_N;
    (* If wheel slip is active (>8%), apparent friction approaches peak road-tire adhesion mu *)
    IF (ABS(rSlipRatio_FL) > 0.08) OR (ABS(rSlipRatio_FR) > 0.08) OR
       (ABS(rSlipRatio_RL) > 0.08) OR (ABS(rSlipRatio_RR) > 0.08) THEN
        rEstimatedFrictionMu := (rEstimatedFrictionMu * (1.0 - rFrictionObserverGain)) +
                                (LIMIT(0.15, rApparentFrictionDemand, 0.95) * rFrictionObserverGain);
    END_IF;
END_IF;
rTireAdhesionCoeff_Est := rEstimatedFrictionMu;

(* Dynamic Anti-Slip Regulation (ASR) Traction Cutback Multipliers *)
IF (rSlipRatio_FL > 0.15) THEN
    rTorqueScale_FL := MAX(0.20, 1.0 - (rSlipRatio_FL - 0.15) * 4.0);
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rTorqueScale_FL := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_FR > 0.15) THEN
    rTorqueScale_FR := MAX(0.20, 1.0 - (rSlipRatio_FR - 0.15) * 4.0);
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rTorqueScale_FR := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_RL > 0.15) THEN
    rTorqueScale_RL := MAX(0.20, 1.0 - (rSlipRatio_RL - 0.15) * 4.0);
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rTorqueScale_RL := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_RR > 0.15) THEN
    rTorqueScale_RR := MAX(0.20, 1.0 - (rSlipRatio_RR - 0.15) * 4.0);
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    rTorqueScale_RR := 1.0;
END_IF;

IF (rTorqueScale_FL = 1.0) AND (rTorqueScale_FR = 1.0) AND (rTorqueScale_RL = 1.0) AND (rTorqueScale_RR = 1.0) THEN
    bTireSlipMitigationActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 7.0 6-STATE MULTIVARIABLE STATE-SPACE MODEL & REAL-TIME MPC OPTIMIZATION                  *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* States:                                                                                  *)
(*   x[1]: Lateral velocity v_y [m/s]                                                       *)
(*   x[2]: Chassis yaw rate r [rad/s]                                                       *)
(*   x[3]: Lateral path error e_y [m]                                                       *)
(*   x[4]: Heading angle error e_psi [rad]                                                  *)
(*   x[5]: Chassis roll angle phi [rad]                                                     *)
(*   x[6]: Chassis roll angular velocity p [rad/s]                                          *)
(* Controls:                                                                                *)
(*   u[1]: Front steering angle command delta_f [rad]                                       *)
(*   u[2]: Rear steering angle command delta_r [rad]                                        *)
(*   u[3]: Active direct yaw moment delta_M_z [Nm]                                          *)
(*   u[4]: Commanded longitudinal acceleration a_x [m/s2]                                   *)

IF NOT bMatricesInitialized THEN
    (* Discrete System Transition Matrix A_mat (6x6) for Ts = 10 ms *)
    A_mat[1,1] := 0.9650; A_mat[1,2] := -0.0450;A_mat[1,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[1,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[1,5] := 0.0120;  A_mat[1,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[2,1] := -0.0180;A_mat[2,2] := 0.9480; A_mat[2,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[2,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[2,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[3,1] := 0.0100; A_mat[3,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[3,3] := 1.0000; A_mat[3,4] := 0.0850; A_mat[3,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[3,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[4,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,2] := 0.0100; A_mat[4,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[4,4] := 1.0000; A_mat[4,5] := 0.0000;  A_mat[4,6] := 0.0000;
    A_mat[5,1] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[5,5] := 0.9850;  A_mat[5,6] := 0.0098;
    A_mat[6,1] := -0.0250;A_mat[6,2] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,3] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,4] := 0.0000; A_mat[6,5] := -0.2850; A_mat[6,6] := 0.9120;

    (* Discrete Input Coupling Matrix B_mat (6x4) *)
    B_mat[1,1] := 0.1850; B_mat[1,2] := 0.1650; B_mat[1,3] := 0.0000;    B_mat[1,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[2,1] := 0.1420; B_mat[2,2] := -0.1380;B_mat[2,3] := 0.000015;  B_mat[2,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[3,1] := 0.0000; B_mat[3,2] := 0.0000; B_mat[3,3] := 0.0000;    B_mat[3,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[4,1] := 0.0000; B_mat[4,2] := 0.0000; B_mat[4,3] := 0.0000;    B_mat[4,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[5,1] := 0.0000; B_mat[5,2] := 0.0000; B_mat[5,3] := 0.0000;    B_mat[5,4] := 0.0000;
    B_mat[6,1] := 0.0450; B_mat[6,2] := 0.0380; B_mat[6,3] := 0.000002;  B_mat[6,4] := 0.0000;

    (* Identity Matrix for Direct State Observation C_mat (6x6) *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            IF iRow = iCol THEN
                C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 1.0;
            ELSE
                C_mat[iRow, iCol] := 0.0;
            END_IF;
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Tuning Penalty Weights: Q_diag on state errors, R_diag on actuator effort *)
    Q_diag[1] := 0.50;  (* Lateral velocity suppression *)
    Q_diag[2] := 1.20;  (* Yaw rate tracking *)
    Q_diag[3] := 8.50;  (* Critical priority: Lateral path deviation e_y *)
    Q_diag[4] := 5.00;  (* High priority: Heading angle error e_psi *)
    Q_diag[5] := 3.50;  (* Anti-rollover: Roll angle penalty *)
    Q_diag[6] := 1.00;  (* Roll angular rate damping *)

    R_diag[1] := 2.50;  (* Front steering rate penalty *)
    R_diag[2] := 2.50;  (* Rear steering rate penalty *)
    R_diag[3] := 0.00005;(* Yaw moment torque effort penalty *)
    R_diag[4] := 1.50;  (* Acceleration jerk effort penalty *)

    H_diag[1] := 5.50;
    H_diag[2] := 5.50;
    H_diag[3] := 0.00010;
    H_diag[4] := 3.20;

    bMatricesInitialized := TRUE;
END_IF;

(* Populate State Vector x_state from Estimator & Sensor Data *)
x_state[1] := rChassisLatVel_ms;
x_state[2] := rVotedYawRate_degs * (3.14159265 / 180.0);
x_state[3] := rLateralPathDev_mm * 0.001; (* mm to m *)
x_state[4] := rHeadingAngleDev_deg * (3.14159265 / 180.0);
x_state[5] := rVotedRollAngle_deg * (3.14159265 / 180.0);
x_state[6] := rVotedRollRate_degs * (3.14159265 / 180.0);

(* Populate Target Reference State Vector x_ref *)
x_ref[1] := 0.0;
x_ref[2] := (rRefVehicleVelocity_kmh / 3.6) * rRefPathCurvature_radm; (* Steady-state yaw rate *)
x_ref[3] := 0.0; (* Zero lateral error *)
x_ref[4] := 0.0; (* Zero heading orientation error *)
x_ref[5] := 0.0; (* Upright zero roll *)
x_ref[6] := 0.0;

(* Real-Time Quadratic Cost Gradient Descent Optimization *)
IF bMpcTrackingEnable AND (iState = 50 OR iState = 60 OR iState = 70) THEN
    (* Compute Predicted State x_next = A * x + B * u *)
    FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
        x_next[iRow] := 0.0;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 6 DO
            x_next[iRow] := x_next[iRow] + A_mat[iRow, iCol] * x_state[iCol];
        END_FOR;
        FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
            x_next[iRow] := x_next[iRow] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * u_mpc[iCol];
        END_FOR;
    END_FOR;

    (* Compute Gradient of Quadratic Cost: grad_J = B^T * Q * (x_next - x_ref) + R * (u - u_prev) *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        grad_J[iCol] := 0.0;
        FOR iRow := 1 TO 6 DO
            grad_J[iCol] := grad_J[iCol] + B_mat[iRow, iCol] * Q_diag[iRow] * (x_next[iRow] - x_ref[iRow]);
        END_FOR;
        grad_J[iCol] := grad_J[iCol] + R_diag[iCol] * (u_mpc[iCol] - u_prev[iCol]);
    END_FOR;

    (* Iterative Gradient Descent Step: delta_u = - grad_J / H_diag *)
    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        delta_u[iCol] := - (grad_J[iCol] / H_diag[iCol]) * rStepAlpha;
        u_mpc[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol] + delta_u[iCol];
    END_FOR;

    (* Actuator Physical Saturation Constraints *)
    u_mpc[1] := LIMIT(-0.7854, u_mpc[1], 0.7854); (* Front steer limit +/- 45 deg (+/- 0.785 rad) *)
    u_mpc[2] := LIMIT(-0.7854, u_mpc[2], 0.7854); (* Rear steer limit +/- 45 deg (+/- 0.785 rad) *)
    u_mpc[3] := LIMIT(-25000.0, u_mpc[3], 25000.0); (* Torque vectoring yaw moment +/- 25k Nm *)
    u_mpc[4] := LIMIT(-2.5, u_mpc[4], 1.5); (* Accel/Braking limit -2.5 to +1.5 m/s2 *)

    FOR iCol := 1 TO 4 DO
        u_prev[iCol] := u_mpc[iCol];
    END_FOR;
    bPathTrackingActive := TRUE;
ELSE
    u_mpc[1] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[2] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[3] := 0.0;
    u_mpc[4] := 0.0;
    bPathTrackingActive := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 8.0 4WID-4WIS ACTUATOR ALLOCATION & DYNAMIC TORQUE VECTORING                              *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Base Ackermann Steering Angles from MPC outputs *)
rTargetAckermannDeltaF_rad := u_mpc[1];
rTargetAckermannDeltaR_rad := u_mpc[2];

(* Check for Crab Steer Mode (pure translation with zero chassis yaw) *)
IF bAllowCrabSteering AND (ABS(rRefHeadingAngle_deg - (rEkf_Psi_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265)) < 1.0) AND
   (ABS(rLateralPathDev_mm) > 25.0) THEN
    (* Set equal front and rear steer angles for diagonal shift *)
    rTargetCrabAngle_rad := LIMIT(-0.5236, (rLateralPathDev_mm * 0.001) * 0.25, 0.5236);
    rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg := rTargetCrabAngle_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
    rCornerSteer_FR_Raw_deg := rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg;
    rCornerSteer_RL_Raw_deg := rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg;
    rCornerSteer_RR_Raw_deg := rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg;
ELSE
    (* Standard Ackermann / Counter-phase steer allocation *)
    rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg := rTargetAckermannDeltaF_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
    rCornerSteer_FR_Raw_deg := rTargetAckermannDeltaF_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
    rCornerSteer_RL_Raw_deg := rTargetAckermannDeltaR_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
    rCornerSteer_RR_Raw_deg := rTargetAckermannDeltaR_rad * 180.0 / 3.14159265;
END_IF;

(* Slew Rate Limiter on Steering Actuators (Max 35 deg/s) *)
rSteerAngleCmd_FL_deg := LIMIT(rPrevSteerCmd_FL_deg - (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s),
                               rCornerSteer_FL_Raw_deg,
                               rPrevSteerCmd_FL_deg + (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s));
rSteerAngleCmd_FR_deg := LIMIT(rPrevSteerCmd_FR_deg - (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s),
                               rCornerSteer_FR_Raw_deg,
                               rPrevSteerCmd_FR_deg + (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s));
rSteerAngleCmd_RL_deg := LIMIT(rPrevSteerCmd_RL_deg - (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s),
                               rCornerSteer_RL_Raw_deg,
                               rPrevSteerCmd_RL_deg + (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s));
rSteerAngleCmd_RR_deg := LIMIT(rPrevSteerCmd_RR_deg - (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s),
                               rCornerSteer_RR_Raw_deg,
                               rPrevSteerCmd_RR_deg + (rMaxSteeringRate_degs * rSampleTime_Ts_s));

rPrevSteerCmd_FL_deg := rSteerAngleCmd_FL_deg;
rPrevSteerCmd_FR_deg := rSteerAngleCmd_FR_deg;
rPrevSteerCmd_RL_deg := rSteerAngleCmd_RL_deg;
rPrevSteerCmd_RR_deg := rSteerAngleCmd_RR_deg;

(* Drive Torque Calculation: Base Longitudinal Tractive Demand + Torque Vectoring Yaw Moment *)
IF (u_mpc[4] >= 0.0) THEN
    rBaseDriveTorque_Nm := (u_mpc[4] * rMass_Total_kg * rTireRollingRadius_m * 0.25);
ELSE
    rBaseDriveTorque_Nm := 0.0; (* Negative acceleration handled by service brakes *)
END_IF;

(* Torque Vectoring Moment Allocation across Left and Right Tracks *)
(* delta_Mz = (F_right - F_left) * (W / 2) -> delta_T = delta_Mz * R_eff / W *)
rYawMomentDiffTorque_Nm := (u_mpc[3] + rRolloverTorqueVector_M_z) * rTireRollingRadius_m / rTrackWidth_W_m;

rCornerTorque_FL_Raw_Nm := (rBaseDriveTorque_Nm - (rYawMomentDiffTorque_Nm * 0.5)) * rTorqueScale_FL;
rCornerTorque_FR_Raw_Nm := (rBaseDriveTorque_Nm + (rYawMomentDiffTorque_Nm * 0.5)) * rTorqueScale_FR;
rCornerTorque_RL_Raw_Nm := (rBaseDriveTorque_Nm - (rYawMomentDiffTorque_Nm * 0.5)) * rTorqueScale_RL;
rCornerTorque_RR_Raw_Nm := (rBaseDriveTorque_Nm + (rYawMomentDiffTorque_Nm * 0.5)) * rTorqueScale_RR;

(* Apply Inverter Drive Ready Permissives and Torque Saturation *)
IF bInverterReady_FL AND (iState >= 40) AND (iState < 100) THEN
    rDriveTorqueCmd_FL_Nm := LIMIT(0.0, rCornerTorque_FL_Raw_Nm, rMaxMotorTorque_Nm);
ELSE
    rDriveTorqueCmd_FL_Nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF bInverterReady_FR AND (iState >= 40) AND (iState < 100) THEN
    rDriveTorqueCmd_FR_Nm := LIMIT(0.0, rCornerTorque_FR_Raw_Nm, rMaxMotorTorque_Nm);
ELSE
    rDriveTorqueCmd_FR_Nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF bInverterReady_RL AND (iState >= 40) AND (iState < 100) THEN
    rDriveTorqueCmd_RL_Nm := LIMIT(0.0, rCornerTorque_RL_Raw_Nm, rMaxMotorTorque_Nm);
ELSE
    rDriveTorqueCmd_RL_Nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

IF bInverterReady_RR AND (iState >= 40) AND (iState < 100) THEN
    rDriveTorqueCmd_RR_Nm := LIMIT(0.0, rCornerTorque_RR_Raw_Nm, rMaxMotorTorque_Nm);
ELSE
    rDriveTorqueCmd_RR_Nm := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 9.0 DUAL-CIRCUIT ELECTRO-HYDRAULIC SERVICE BRAKING & ABS GOVERNOR                         *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
IF (u_mpc[4] < -0.05) THEN
    (* Demand proportional hydraulic brake pressure based on deceleration demand *)
    rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar := LIMIT(0.0, ABS(u_mpc[4]) * 60.0, rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar);
ELSE
    rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Corner ABS Slip Mitigation: If wheel lockup slip is detected (< -15%), release brake pressure *)
IF (rSlipRatio_FL < -0.15) THEN
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FL_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar * 0.30;
    bAbsIntervention_FL := TRUE;
ELSE
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FL_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar;
    bAbsIntervention_FL := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_FR < -0.15) THEN
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FR_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar * 0.30;
    bAbsIntervention_FR := TRUE;
ELSE
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FR_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar;
    bAbsIntervention_FR := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_RL < -0.15) THEN
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RL_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar * 0.30;
    bAbsIntervention_RL := TRUE;
ELSE
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RL_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar;
    bAbsIntervention_RL := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF (rSlipRatio_RR < -0.15) THEN
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RR_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar * 0.30;
    bAbsIntervention_RR := TRUE;
ELSE
    rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RR_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar;
    bAbsIntervention_RR := FALSE;
END_IF;
rMasterBrakePressureCmd_bar := rMasterServiceBrakeDemand_bar;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 10.0 MULTI-STAGE FINITE STATE MACHINE (FSM) EXECUTION CONTROL                             *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
tStateTimer(IN := (iState = iPrevState), PT := T#3600S);
iPrevState := iState;

CASE iState OF
    0: (* STATE 0: UNINITIALIZED / POWER-ON HARDWARE SELF-TEST *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        tBootDiagTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#2S);
        IF tBootDiagTimer.Q THEN
            tBootDiagTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 10; (* Proceed to 2oo3 Sensor Diagnostics *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: 2oo3 SENSOR INTEGRITY & TMR VALIDATION *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        IF (dwAlarmWord1 = 16#0000_0000) AND (dwAlarmWord2 = 16#0000_0000) THEN
            IF bMagFront_A_Healthy AND bMagFront_B_Healthy AND bImuYaw_A_Healthy AND bImuYaw_B_Healthy THEN
                iState := 20; (* Proceed to Hydraulic Pre-Charge *)
            ELSE
                dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0010; (* Sensor degraded during boot *)
                iState := 20;
            END_IF;
        ELSE
            iState := 100; (* Alarm latched, jump to safe shutdown *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: HYDRAULIC SERVICE BRAKE PRE-CHARGE & STEER ZERO SEEK *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        tBrakePrechargeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1S);
        IF tBrakePrechargeTimer.Q THEN
            tBrakePrechargeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF (rMainHydraulicSupplyPress_bar >= 140.0) THEN
                iState := 30; (* Proceed to Weigh-in & CoG Calibration *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmWord1 := dwAlarmWord1 OR 16#0000_0040; (* Brake supply pressure low *)
                iState := 100;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: STATIC LOAD WEIGH-IN & 3D COG ENVELOPE INITIALIZATION *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        tWeighInStabilizeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#1500MS);
        IF tWeighInStabilizeTimer.Q THEN
            tWeighInStabilizeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF (rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t >= 28.0) AND (rTotalGrossVehicleMass_t <= 70.0) THEN
                bSystemReady := TRUE;
                iState := 40; (* Standby Armed *)
            ELSE
                dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0004; (* Container load verification out of range *)
                iState := 100;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    40: (* STATE 40: STANDBY ARMED / MISSION DISPATCH READY *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        IF bEnableSystem AND bAutoPathTrackingEnable THEN
            bSystemRunning := TRUE;
            iState := 50; (* Enter Autonomous Transit Tracking *)
        END_IF;

    50: (* STATE 50: NOMINAL 4WID-4WIS PATH TRACKING & REAL-TIME MPC TRANSIT *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        IF NOT bEnableSystem THEN
            iState := 40; (* Return to Standby *)
        ELSIF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.75) THEN
            iState := 80; (* Transition to Active Anti-Rollover Intervention *)
        ELSIF bTireSlipMitigationActive THEN
            iState := 70; (* Transition to Slip Synchronization Engine *)
        ELSIF bAllowCrabSteering AND (ABS(rLateralPathDev_mm) > 25.0) THEN
            iState := 60; (* Transition to Lateral Crab Steer Docking *)
        ELSIF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#0000_0000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#0000_0000) THEN
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: CRAB-STEER / OMNIDIRECTIONAL SHIP-TO-SHORE (STS) QUAY DOCKING *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        IF (ABS(rLateralPathDev_mm) <= 10.0) OR NOT bAllowCrabSteering THEN
            iState := 50; (* Return to Nominal Tracking *)
        ELSIF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.75) THEN
            iState := 80;
        ELSIF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#0000_0000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#0000_0000) THEN
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    70: (* STATE 70: TIRE SLIP SYNCHRONIZATION & TRACTIVE ADHESION MITIGATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        tSlipRecoveryTimer(IN := NOT bTireSlipMitigationActive, PT := T#1S);
        IF tSlipRecoveryTimer.Q THEN
            tSlipRecoveryTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iState := 50; (* Slip resolved, return to Nominal Transit *)
        ELSIF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.75) THEN
            iState := 80;
        ELSIF (dwAlarmWord1 <> 16#0000_0000) OR (dwAlarmWord2 <> 16#0000_0000) THEN
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    80: (* STATE 80: ACTIVE ANTI-ROLLOVER INTERVENTION & EMERGENCY SPEED DERATING *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bAntiRolloverActive := TRUE;
        tRolloverDerateTimer(IN := (ABS(rFilteredLTR) < 0.45), PT := T#2S);
        IF tRolloverDerateTimer.Q THEN
            tRolloverDerateTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;
            iState := 50; (* Rollover hazard mitigated, return to nominal *)
        ELSIF (ABS(rFilteredLTR) >= 0.88) THEN
            dwAlarmWord2 := dwAlarmWord2 OR 16#0000_0008; (* Critical rollover runaway *)
            iState := 100;
        END_IF;

    90: (* STATE 90: GRACEFUL DEGRADED DEAD-RECKONING NAVIGATION *)
        bSystemReady := TRUE;
        bSystemRunning := TRUE;
        bDegradedNavModeActive := TRUE;
        IF bVotedMagPeg_Front OR bVotedMagPeg_Rear THEN
            bDegradedNavModeActive := FALSE;
            iState := 50; (* Magnetic fix re-established *)
        END_IF;

    100: (* STATE 100: SIL-3 SAFETY SHUTDOWN & CONTROLLED EMERGENCY BRAKING *)
        bSystemReady := FALSE;
        bSystemRunning := FALSE;
        bSystemTripped := TRUE;
        bPathTrackingActive := FALSE;
        bAntiRolloverActive := FALSE;
        bTireSlipMitigationActive := FALSE;
        
        (* Inhibit all drive torque commands *)
        rDriveTorqueCmd_FL_Nm := 0.0;
        rDriveTorqueCmd_FR_Nm := 0.0;
        rDriveTorqueCmd_RL_Nm := 0.0;
        rDriveTorqueCmd_RR_Nm := 0.0;
        
        (* Apply full dual-circuit mechanical brakes *)
        rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FL_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
        rHydraulicBrakeCmd_FR_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
        rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RL_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
        rHydraulicBrakeCmd_RR_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
        rMasterBrakePressureCmd_bar := rMaxServiceBrakePress_bar;
        
        IF bResetFaults AND (dwAlarmWord1 = 16#0000_0000) AND (dwAlarmWord2 = 16#0000_0000) THEN
            bSystemTripped := FALSE;
            iState := 0; (* Reset sequence back to boot self-test *)
        END_IF;
END_CASE;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 11.0 GRACEFUL DEGRADATION, SENSOR FAULT MITIGATION & DERATE MANAGEMENT                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* Evaluate overall channel degradation and adjust vehicle operational limits *)
IF (dwDegradationWord <> 16#0000_0000) THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0080; (* Redundant sensor channel degradation active *)
    (* Cap maximum speed to 15 km/h under degraded sensor conditions *)
    IF (rVehicleSpeedEst_kmh > 15.0) THEN
        rBaseDriveTorque_Nm := rBaseDriveTorque_Nm * 0.70;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Transponder Missed Peg Watchdog *)
tMagLostDebounceTimer(IN := NOT (bVotedMagPeg_Front OR bVotedMagPeg_Rear) AND (iState = 50), PT := T#4S);
IF tMagLostDebounceTimer.Q THEN
    dwWarningWord := dwWarningWord OR 16#0000_0100; (* Transponder peg lost: fallback to dead-reckoning *)
    iState := 90; (* Transition to Degraded Dead-Reckoning Navigation *)
END_IF;

(* ========================================================================================= *)
(* 12.0 ISA-18.2 BIT-PACKED STATUS WORD & ALARM ASSEMBLY                                     *)
(* ========================================================================================= *)
dwSystemStatusWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF bSystemReady THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0001; END_IF;
IF bSystemRunning THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
IF bSystemTripped THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0004; END_IF;
IF bPathTrackingActive THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0008; END_IF;
IF bAntiRolloverActive THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0010; END_IF;
IF bTireSlipMitigationActive THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0020; END_IF;
IF bDegradedNavModeActive THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0040; END_IF;
IF (iState = 50) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0100; END_IF;
IF (iState = 60) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0200; END_IF;
IF (iState = 70) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0400; END_IF;
IF (iState = 80) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_0800; END_IF;
IF (iState = 90) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_1000; END_IF;
IF (iState = 100) THEN dwSystemStatusWord := dwSystemStatusWord OR 16#0000_8000; END_IF;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
